sec_priorities_sub: Guidelines-defined steps prioritized by neural network for maximal CHD risk reduction
rec_smoking_rationale: Tobacco smoke damages vascular endothelium and accelerates atherogenesis. Cessation cuts coronary catastrophe risk by 50% within 1 year.
rec_smoking_action: Consult a specialist for a structured smoking cessation or nicotine replacement protocol.
rec_bp_title: Blood Pressure Optimization to Target Range
rec_bp_rationale: ESC/ESH 2018 and WHO 2021 recommend target BP < 130/80 mmHg to prevent myocardial infarction and stroke.
rec_bp_action: Limit dietary sodium (< 5 g/day), maintain a BP home log, and adjust antihypertensive therapy with a physician.
rec_lipids_rationale: A 20% reduction in total cholesterol stabilizes atherosclerotic plaques and cuts 10-year vascular events.
rec_lipids_action: Adopt a cardioprotective dietary pattern rich in soluble fiber and unsaturated fats; discuss statin therapy if indicated.
rec_weight_rationale: A 5–10% weight loss improves hemodynamics, decreases insulin resistance, and attenuates vascular inflammation.
rec_weight_action: Engage in 150–300 min/week of moderate-intensity aerobic exercise alongside a modest caloric deficit.
rec_glucose_rationale: Elevated fasting glucose accelerates vascular end-glycation products and micro/macrovascular damage.
rec_glucose_action: Obtain an HbA1c test and consult an endocrinologist for early metabolic evaluation.
rec_maintenance_optimal: All clinical biomarkers are within optimal target ranges. Continue an active lifestyle with biannual screenings.
rec_combined_desc: By adopting all recommendations, 10-year CHD risk drops by {chd} pp, heart age rejuvenates by {va} years, and life expectancy increases by {le} years.
xai_heading: Feature Attributions to Individual Risk (Integrated Gradients)
xai_desc: Shows how much each individual biomarker increases (+) or decreases (−) your 10-year CHD risk compared to an optimal reference profile.
traj_desc: Comparison between natural aging trajectory and the optimized intervention trajectory.
